headline: Flagship backlog fully closed; Weight Surgery step 2 runs in slot a
lede: The builder ladder verified dry twice at fresh tips — and for the first time every honest gap across all four flagship READMEs (SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD, Myst) is CLOSED by a merged PR. The studio still shipped this window: ADVENTURE's roaming bat and a public AI RESEARCH section; slot a is mid-run on Weight Surgery step 2. The factory's next milestone is now Jon's open call (#1557).

notes.text: Weight Surgery step 2 live in slot a: Qwen finds its own edit across 20 passes, scored against the MIT p50c row — result lands on the weightsurgery demo when it ships.
AI RESEARCH section merged: hand-written weights, Concordance and a lander RL page now live at jalfern.com/retrogames/research/.

Flagship backlog fully empty for the first time: all 20 honest gaps across SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD and Myst READMEs closed by merged PRs; two dry ladder cycles in a row confirm the queue generator is exhausted.
Builder milestone question #1557 awaits Jon — if unanswered by its deadline the recorded default runs: ADVENTURE fairness pass, then promote #838 (Myst toward the 1993 original), then un-stall #1141.
